build_encoder_resnet_dilated: build a ResNet50 dilated encoder using ModelBuilder.build_encoder with arch resnet50dilated for semantic segmentation
build_decoder_ppm_deepsup: build a PPM decoder with deep supervision using ModelBuilder.build_decoder with arch ppm_deepsup for segmentation
